ui_by_bucket.accepted: Show friend; actions: unfriend (deleteFriendship). Other user via sender/receiver compare.
ui_by_bucket.sent: Outgoing pending; action: cancel (deleteFriendship as sender).
ui_by_bucket.received: Incoming pending; actions: accept / decline (updateFriendship). Badge source.
ui_by_bucket.declined: Receiver-only history; action: remove declined (deleteFriendship). No accept CTA.

friendships.timeout_offline: Do not optimistic-commit create, accept, decline, cancel, unfriend, or remove declined. Leave local state unchanged; offer retry when online.
